title: INVESTIGATING DISABILITY REPRESENTATIONS IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating CLIP embedding similarities between images generated from generic vs. specific disability prompts to detect representational defaults (e.g., overrepresentation of mobility impairments). Additionally, evaluating affective framing by comparing the sentiment polarity of images depicting mental disorders versus physical/sensory disabilities using both automatic visual question answering (BLIP VQA) and human pairwise evaluations.
